def unique_with_counts_sorted(lst):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(lst)
    items = list(counts.items())
    items.sort(key=lambda p: (-p[1], p[0]))
    return [[v, c] for v, c in items]

def find_max_sum_subarray_of_size_k(lst, k):
    window_sum = sum(lst[:k])
    max_sum = window_sum
    for i in range(k, len(lst)):
        window_sum += lst[i] - lst[i - k]
        max_sum = max(max_sum, window_sum)
    return max_sum

def find_min_sum_subarray_of_size_k(lst, k):
    window_sum = sum(lst[:k])
    min_sum = window_sum
    for i in range(k, len(lst)):
        window_sum += lst[i] - lst[i - k]
        min_sum = min(min_sum, window_sum)
    return min_sum

def remove_range(lst, start, end):
    return lst[:start] + lst[end:]

def insert_at_index(lst, idx, value):
    return lst[:idx] + [value] + lst[idx:]
